name: Rafael Gutierrez
office: City of Montebello, Member of the City Council, 4th District (Unexpired term ending November 7, 2028)

items.text: Rafael Gutierrez is a teacher and athletic director at Montebello High School. He was Montebello’s elected city treasurer from 2018 to 2022. He supports improving infrastructure and responsible housing projects. He says he will work collaboratively to achieve results for residents.
